_warning: This file is IMMUTABLE. chmod 444. The agent cannot and must not edit it.

guidelines_insights.purpose: Record observable and verifiable behavioral patterns.
rules: Only record a pattern if observed on at least 3 distinct days.
Each pattern: short, factual sentence.
Maximum 30 patterns.
Never record medical, financial, or private data.
Pending items must be actionable.
Remove pending items after 30 days without mention.

guidelines_soul.purpose: Define agent personality, tone, behavioral rules.
rules: NEVER alter: name, mission, or values.
Allowed: refine behavior rules based on explicit user feedback.
Maximum 15 behavioral rules.

guidelines_users.purpose: Maintain resident profiles based on observation.
rules: Update preferences only on 3+ demonstrations or explicit request.
Never infer emotional/health states as permanent.
Keep minimal data.

guidelines_agent_automations.purpose: Agent can propose and create simple native HA automations.
rules: Every automation requires explicit approval via Telegram.
Keep simple: one trigger, one action. No Jinja2 in actions.
Maximum 20 automations.
Never create platform: conversation triggers.
Never touch files outside the agent automation file.
Confirm via Telegram after creation.
In weekly compilation, review and propose removing unused ones.

guidelines_monitoring.purpose: Monitor HA health and inform proactively.
rules: Critical errors: inform immediately with suggested fix.
SELF_ERRORS (from telegram_bot, conversation, automation, shell_command) are caused by the agent — always report with context.
Available updates: include in 21h briefing only.
New devices: ask user to name and configure.
Do not repeat same error more than once per hour.
